description: This script provides an API for interacting with Xbox devices via REST API, including functions for managing packages, processes, files, and device info, as well as a command-line tester interface.

classes.name: Xb1NetworkApi
classes.description: Class providing an interface to communicate with a remote Xbox device via REST API, including methods for device info, package management, process control, file operations, and user management.

methods.name: GetFilesRecursively
methods.description: Recursively collects all files in a directory and returns a dictionary mapping directory names to file paths.

methods.name: _PrintAndRaiseIfError
methods.description: Prints detailed error information and raises an HTTPError if the response status is not OK.

methods.name: InteractiveCommandLineMode
methods.description: Provides an interactive CLI to test and inspect Xbox device packages, processes, files, and settings.
